evidence.detail: season_chooser() only marks seasons disabled when not in legal_seasons; no 'played but not legal' or 'legal but not played' distinction exists
card view sets legal_seasons from card.legalities but never sets a 'played_seasons' set for the chooser
Issue comment: 'Tournaments-only is a wrinkle here' — product judgment required on how tournament-only mode interacts with 'was-legal-not-played' deemphasis

triage.notes: Requires: (1) new data fetch for which seasons had decks with this card, (2) a new 'deemphasized but clickable' state in season_chooser separate from 'disabled', (3) product decision on tournaments-only mode. Scope is larger than easy-fix.
